title: Two Parallel Radiating Plates View Factor (F12)
description: Classical analytical benchmark of two facing 1 m x 1 m parallel square plates separated by 1 m for Monte Carlo form-factor (FFCAL) and RADK verification.
code:
C Two Parallel 1m x 1m Radiating Plates Benchmark (F12 ~ 0.1998)
HEADER OPTIONS DATA
  TITLE = Two Parallel Radiating Plates View Factor
  MODEL = PARALLEL_PLATES
  UNITS = SI
  RAYS = 5000

HEADER SURFACE DATA
  S PLATE1 RECTANGLE W=1.0 H=1.0 NODE=101 PROP=BLACK_PAINT ACTIVE=TOP SHADE=YES
    TX=0.0 TY=0.0 TZ=0.0
  S PLATE2 RECTANGLE W=1.0 H=1.0 NODE=102 PROP=BLACK_PAINT ACTIVE=BOTTOM SHADE=YES
    TX=0.0 TY=0.0 TZ=1.0

HEADER OPERATIONS DATA
  FFCAL
  CALL RKCAL(EPS=0.001)

END OF DATA

title: Concentric Cylinders Annular Radiation Enclosure
description: Concentric cylindrical cryogenic radiation shield enclosing a warm inner tube with top and bottom circular endcap disks for RADK exchange factors.
code:
C Concentric Cylinders Annular Radiation Enclosure
HEADER OPTIONS DATA
  TITLE = Concentric Cylinders Annular Enclosure
  MODEL = ANNULAR_SHIELD
  UNITS = SI
  RAYS = 6000

HEADER SURFACE DATA
  S INNER CYLINDER R=0.30 L=2.0 NODE=101 PROP=BLACK_PAINT ACTIVE=TOP SHADE=YES
  S OUTER CYLINDER R=0.60 L=2.0 NODE=102 PROP=SILVER_TEFLON ACTIVE=BOTTOM SHADE=YES
  S CAP_BOT DISK R=0.60 NODE=103 PROP=GOLD_KAPTON ACTIVE=TOP SHADE=YES TZ=0.0
  S CAP_TOP DISK R=0.60 NODE=104 PROP=GOLD_KAPTON ACTIVE=BOTTOM SHADE=YES TZ=2.0

HEADER OPERATIONS DATA
  FFCAL
  CALL RKCAL(EPS=0.001)

END OF DATA

title: CubeSat 6-Surface External Space View Factors
description: Six-surface 3U CubeSat external thermal radiation model in a 420 km ISS-inclination low-Earth orbit computing solar, albedo, and planetary IR heating.
code:
C 3U CubeSat 6-Surface External LEO Heating Model
HEADER OPTIONS DATA
  TITLE = 3U CubeSat External Orbital Heating
  MODEL = CUBESAT_3U
  UNITS = SI
  RAYS = 5000

HEADER SURFACE DATA
  S FACE_PX RECTANGLE W=0.10 H=0.30 NODE=101 PROP=0.88, 0.84 ACTIVE=TOP SHADE=YES TX=0.05 ROTY=90
  S FACE_NX RECTANGLE W=0.10 H=0.30 NODE=102 PROP=0.88, 0.84 ACTIVE=TOP SHADE=YES TX=-0.05 ROTY=-90
  S FACE_PY RECTANGLE W=0.10 H=0.30 NODE=103 PROP=SILVER_TEFLON ACTIVE=TOP SHADE=YES TY=0.05 ROTX=-90
  S FACE_NY RECTANGLE W=0.10 H=0.30 NODE=104 PROP=SILVER_TEFLON ACTIVE=TOP SHADE=YES TY=-0.05 ROTX=90
  S FACE_PZ RECTANGLE W=0.10 H=0.10 NODE=105 PROP=WHITE_PAINT_Z93 ACTIVE=TOP SHADE=YES TZ=0.15
  S FACE_NZ RECTANGLE W=0.10 H=0.10 NODE=106 PROP=GOLD_KAPTON ACTIVE=BOTTOM SHADE=YES TZ=-0.15

HEADER ORBIT DATA
  PLANET = EARTH
  ALTITUDE = 420.0
  BETA = 30.0
  SOLAR = 1361.0
  ALBEDO = 0.30
  PLANETIR = 237.0

HEADER OPERATIONS DATA
  FFCAL
  CALL RKCAL(EPS=0.001)
  QCAL

END OF DATA

title: Parabolic Dish Antenna Solar and Albedo Heating
description: High-gain parabolic communications reflector with conical feed horn, cylindrical boom, and spacecraft bus deck evaluated for orbital solar-albedo heat loads.
code:
C Parabolic High-Gain Dish Antenna Orbital Solar/Albedo Heating
HEADER OPTIONS DATA
  TITLE = Parabolic Dish Antenna Solar Heating
  MODEL = HGA_ANTENNA
  UNITS = SI
  RAYS = 8000

HEADER SURFACE DATA
  S DISH1 PARABOLOID R=1.5 F=0.75 NODE=201 PROP=WHITE_PAINT_Z93 ACTIVE=BOTH SHADE=YES
  S FEED1 CONE R1=0.12 R2=0.04 L=0.25 NODE=202 PROP=GOLD_KAPTON ACTIVE=TOP SHADE=YES TZ=0.75
  S BOOM1 CYLINDER R=0.03 L=0.80 NODE=203 PROP=0.35, 0.80 ACTIVE=TOP SHADE=YES TX=0.40
  S DECK1 DISK R=1.10 NODE=204 PROP=SILVER_TEFLON ACTIVE=TOP SHADE=YES TZ=-0.60

HEADER ORBIT DATA
  PLANET = EARTH
  ALTITUDE = 780.0
  BETA = 45.0
  SOLAR = 1361.0
  ALBEDO = 0.28
  PLANETIR = 235.0

HEADER OPERATIONS DATA
  FFCAL
  CALL RKCAL(EPS=0.001)
  QCAL

END OF DATA

title: GEO Satellite Thermal-Radiation Coupled Suite
description: Geosynchronous communications satellite TRASYS radiation geometry (bus, north/south radiators, solar wings, HGA dish) paired with its companion SINDA thermal network.
code:

HEADER OPTIONS DATA
  TITLE = GEO Communications Satellite Radiation Model
  MODEL = GEO_COMSAT
  UNITS = SI
  RAYS = 10000

HEADER SURFACE DATA
  S BUS_CYL CYLINDER R=1.2 L=2.4 NODE=101 PROP=GOLD_KAPTON ACTIVE=TOP SHADE=YES
  S RAD_N RECTANGLE W=2.2 H=1.8 NODE=102 PROP=SILVER_TEFLON ACTIVE=TOP SHADE=YES TY=1.25 ROTX=-90
  S RAD_S RECTANGLE W=2.2 H=1.8 NODE=103 PROP=SILVER_TEFLON ACTIVE=TOP SHADE=YES TY=-1.25 ROTX=90
  S WING_E RECTANGLE W=6.0 H=2.0 NODE=104 PROP=0.86, 0.82 ACTIVE=BOTH SHADE=YES TX=4.5
  S WING_W RECTANGLE W=6.0 H=2.0 NODE=105 PROP=0.86, 0.82 ACTIVE=BOTH SHADE=YES TX=-4.5
  S HGA_DISH PARABOLOID R=1.4 F=0.7 NODE=106 PROP=WHITE_PAINT_Z93 ACTIVE=TOP SHADE=YES TZ=1.6

HEADER ORBIT DATA
  PLANET = EARTH
  ALTITUDE = 35786.0
  BETA = 0.0
  SOLAR = 1361.0
  ALBEDO = 0.30
  PLANETIR = 237.0

HEADER OPERATIONS DATA
  FFCAL
  CALL RKCAL(EPS=0.0005)
  QCAL

END OF DATA
